about.title: About
about.techFooter: Bachelor Thesis · Bern University of Applied Sciences · 2026
about.authorRole: Bachelor Thesis · BFH Business Information Technology
about.s1Body: This comparison portal was developed as part of a Bachelor Thesis at Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH). The goal is to support parents and students in finding the right grammar school preparation course in the Canton of Zurich.
about.s2Body: The portal uses a weighted utility analysis (Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis). Users can decide for themselves which criteria are most important — for example price, quality, flexibility or location. Based on these weightings, providers are evaluated and ranked by total score.
about.s3Body: Course data is automatically collected via web scraping from the providers' websites and updated regularly. An AI-based self-healing mechanism detects structural changes on provider websites and adapts the scrapers automatically. All price information is for orientation only — the current information on the respective provider websites is always authoritative.
about.s4Body: This work was created as part of the Business Information Technology programme at Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH), Department of Business.

zap.title: ZAP Info
zap.subtitle: Central Entrance Examination (ZAP) — Canton of Zurich. Dates and information directly from official sources (zh.ch).
zap.whatBody: The Central Entrance Examination (ZAP) is the examination for entry into a grammar school or vocational baccalaureate school in the Canton of Zurich. It is held annually in March and tests knowledge in mathematics and German.
zap.longBody: 6 years · Entry after the 6th grade of primary school
zap.shortBody: 4 years · Entry after the 2nd or 3rd grade of secondary school
zap.datesSubtitle: Data verified from official sources of the Canton of Zurich (zh.ch).
zap.disclaimer: This data is verified manually from official sources (zh.ch). The official information of the Canton of Zurich is always authoritative. Fully automated updates via web scraping are defined as future work in the roadmap.
